newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASC alters law to clear Coldstream bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASC alters law to clear Coldstream bid.

text.p: The Australian Securities Commission (ASC) said on Wednesday it had modified the Corporations Law to allow Southcorp Holdings Ltd to compulsorily acquire shares in Coldstream Australasia Ltd.
"The (corporate law) relief will allow Southcorp to compulsorily acquire shares in Coldstream which are issued on the excercise of options after the close of Southcorp's offer," ASC said.
"This is the first time the ASC has granted such relief, although the NCSC (National Companies and Securities Commission) previously granted a similar modification," it said.
Southcorp said in July it would compulsorily acquire all of Coldstream's shares.
Southcorp, Australia's largest wine producer, had offered A$1.06 a share for Coldstream, valuing the company at about A$12 million.
